# R fixture

`cfa.json` is a projection of `web/tests/fixtures/holz_cfa.json`, generated by the R engine from lavaan's public HolzingerSwineford1939 example. It retains only analysis ID, module and formatted tables. Values are not hand-authored. Keeping the projection here makes the gateway Docker test context self-contained. Regenerate from the source fixture if the R fixture changes.
